title: Morning: Begin with yourself
headline: Your needs deserve a place in the plan.

implementation: Use SVG layers and interruptible CSS transforms to move the light and notes into place.

guardrail: Keep notes conceptual and avoid implying diagnosis, prescriptions, or an idealized body.

title: Discovery: See possibilities

title: Preparation: Make tomorrow easier
